name: X2_wf6_h10
description: Hold the part a take-profit has not sold past minute 60, take-profit still resting, while a linear prediction of the gain from holding to minute 120 (bp per remainder dollar, net of costs) is at least h; otherwise sell it at market at that minute's close; sell what is left at minute 120.

inputs_meaning.rec: mark / (k sigma), sigma from the take-profit distance (g_tp / 0.6)
inputs_meaning.btc: BTC close vs its close at the fill minute, bp
inputs_meaning.breadth: coins with a research parent fill in minutes m-29..m

fit: OLS, refit each quarter on the tranche-minutes of earlier quarters; out-of-sample eras: selection era plus the same era's earlier quarters (deviation log 20:16 UTC); training frame S* theta 0.5 instant bound
kappa: measured (unused by X2: all its exits are at minutes >= 60)
gates: G1 pooled paired NW t >= 2 over check + 2022-23 at S* theta 0.5 (return path); G2 both eras' mean daily difference > 0 at S* theta 0.5; G3 theta 0.25 pooled t >= 2 and both eras positive; G4 base pooled mean > 0
